newsitem.title: MOROCCO: 23 bus passengers swept away in Moroccan flood.
newsitem.headline: 23 bus passengers swept away in Moroccan flood.

text.p: Twenty-three passengers aboard a bus were swept away by floods when their driver failed to notice a road diversion sign south of the Moroccan capital.

Forty-nine passengers were saved by rescue services using a helicopter and boats after the Sunday night accident on the road from Rabat to Beni Mellal, 180 km (110 miles) to the southeast, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said late on Monday.
The search for the missing 23 was continuing.
